name: Brain Observer
tagline: A weekly sweep that catches drift between your marketing canon and what you actually shipped — then asks: evolve, or hold?
who: Teams where more than one person writes copy, and the positioning that was decided quietly stops matching the copy that ships.
how: Point the agent at your canon (your GTM brain or any positioning/voice docs) and drop the week's shipped output into the workspace. On a weekly schedule it reads the output against the canon and reports every drift as a numbered, counted, quoted observation — then raises each one as a question you can answer from your phone: evolve the canon, or hold the line and fix the copy? A running drift log and rollup show which lines keep losing, which decisions are still open, and which channel drifts every single week.
